Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the civil air patrol to assist the state in homeland security, disaster relief, and search and rescue operations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to authorizing the civil air patrol to conducthomeland security, disaster relief, and search and rescue operationsunder the governance of the Washington state patrol; adding a newsection to chapter 43.43 RCW; creating a new section; and makingappropriations.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the Washingtonwing of the civil air patrol is uniquely suited to assist the state inproviding air search, rescue, and emergency services in the stateincluding response to emergency missions. The legislature furtherfinds that the Washington wing of the civil air patrol is a nonprofit,federally chartered private corporation which is the auxiliary of theUnited States air force and is engaged in cooperation with thenational, state, and local emergency services.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to appropriation, the Washington state patrol shall p. 1 SB 5636disperse funds to the Washington wing of the civil air patrol for thefollowing purposes: Equipment purchase, conduct of search and rescuemissions, and training and education.

The sum of fifty thousand dollars, or asmuch thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal yearending June 30, 2010, and the sum of fifty thousand dollars, or as muchthereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year endingJune 30, 2011, from the general fund to the Washington state patrol forthe purposes of this act.
